sources.observed_scope: Coefficientwise weak measurability implies continuity on separable Hilbert space; a nonseparable counterexample and a stronger operator-measurability result are distinguished.
A specified strongly continuous unitary group has a unique self-adjoint generator; its physical identification is an additional question.

sources.location: Terry Loring, Computing a logarithm of a unitary matrix with general spectrum
sources.observed_scope: Treats skew-Hermitian logarithms without a spectral exclusion; numerical algorithms are not used as proof here.
Studies when stochastic matrices have rate-matrix logarithms and lists possible generators; existence and uniqueness are separate issues.
